title: Sephiria Destiny Inscription Tree — Sapphire Spends & Talents
description: Sephiria Destiny Inscription tree guide: sapphire spends, New Events, Home Repairs, weapon unlocks, and talents.
meta: For sephiria destiny inscription / destiny inscription tree searches.
body:
Destiny Inscription is Sephiria’s permanent meta tree. Sapphires come from dungeon depth and bosses defeated; spending them unlocks weapons, events, inventory, dice, and talent access. This page maps the tree’s branches and the spend order that pays off fastest.

How the tree is organized

  • New Events / fruit skewers lines — unlock systems you will use every run.
  • Home Repairs — progresses village quests and opens Talents (talk to the relevant NPCs after unlocking).
  • Weapon training nodes — required before Morrow’s training grounds grant new weapons.
  • Hard Mode access — after Chapter II, talk to the village tree and pick the Hard Mode dialogue (current path). Older “free Destiny node” text is outdated; see the Hard Mode unlock page.

Early spend order

  1. New Events lines — daily-use systems first.
  2. Home Repairs until Talents open.
  3. Weapon training for the weapon you are learning.
  4. Talents matching that weapon — respec is allowed, so early picks are not permanent.

Talents

Once unlocked, talent points let you bias defense, MP regen, Willpower (luck-like outcomes), dash windows, and more. Guides agree you can respec—use that to match the weapon you are learning (weapons).

Quick FAQ

Where do sapphires come from?
Dungeon depth and bosses defeated — they accrue across runs, so early misses are cheap to recover.

Can you respec?
Yes — guides agree you can respec; match talents to the weapon you are learning.

Is Hard Mode a Destiny node?
Not anymore — the unlock moved to the village tree dialogue in 0.7.55 (see Root’s Retreat).
